user_intent: Strictly ensure agent never selects any company or role requiring technologies not in candidate profile (e.g. non-Java tech, DocuSign, Salesforce, Python, etc.)
why_user_made_such_thinking: Observed roles like DocuSign CLM Tech Lead passing because the title contained Tech Lead and Naukri experience matched, even though candidate does not have that technology stack
why_user_performed_this_way: Clear, uncompromising quality threshold: only apply to companies/roles that directly center around candidate verified technology foundation
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes — added Stage 1.5 Mandatory Primary Technology Anchor requirement: every technical role must explicitly require Java, Spring, Microservices, Enterprise Architecture, API Management, or Backend in title or JD; also reject cards whose tags contain any negative keyword.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes — enforced both at card discovery level and evaluation level. Out-of-domain tech roles are now 100% rejected with 0 score.
evolutionary_takeaways: A senior candidate must never be matched based on generic seniority or location alone; presence of primary core stack anchors (Java/Spring/Enterprise Architecture) is mandatory.
